rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The summary reports confirmation bias twice, groupthink once, and recency bias once, matching the four identified occurrence records. One candidate record is also supplied and no_supported_biases_found is false.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "I named him primary anyway — the domestic history, the breakup timing, the locked door, that's a pattern worth acting on"
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The detective designates the ex as a working theory before forensic results, with a documented plausible resource-allocation rationale and no hidden target bias assigned to this segment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "We walk in already knowing the swab didn't match him"; "once my partner made the case ... the DNA on its own didn't feel like it outweighed that"; "nobody was formally assigned to run down the loitering report"
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Groupthink target: the team converges on retaining the ex as primary despite the known negative DNA result, and the dissenting rear-entrance lead receives no independent follow-up.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "Second witness closes the two-hour gap completely"; "I kept coming back to the fact that it wasn't enough to undo what we'd already built around him"
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Cognitive dissonance target: the closed alibi and detailed alternative description are framed as insufficient to override the already-committed ex theory, with the known negative DNA treated as non-dispositive.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: "that statement got the most space and read as the strongest piece on the page"; "it was also just the last substantial thing that had come in"
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Recency Effects target: the newest detailed witness statement receives disproportionate prominence in the referral memo partly because it was fresh in memory rather than because of a complete comparative evidence review.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly located and describes discounting negative DNA in favor of the ex theory, but it does not capture the hidden collective convergence and dissent-evaluation mechanism of groupthink.

The quote and mechanism fully match the hidden day-three episode, but confirmation bias is a related distinct label rather than the hidden Cognitive dissonance target. It is therefore a mechanism-first match but a strict-label false positive.

The candidate is validly quoted but localizes to the hidden negative-control segment, whose resource-allocation rationale has no planned bias instance. It is a useful abstention diagnostically, but it is a scored false alarm at the candidate-inclusive threshold.

candidates.details: The candidate is explicitly withheld from identified status because day-one prioritization has a legitimate resource-allocation explanation. It has no relation to a hidden positive instance and therefore becomes a false positive only when candidates are counted as detections.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence recency finding fires: one of three positive segments is detected, with no false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding the moderate-confidence groupthink finding detects the briefing segment while the low-confidence day-three finding remains excluded.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence identified findings detects all three positive segments without a segment-level false alarm.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate on the neutral day-one segment adds one false alarm, preserving complete positive-segment recall while reducing precision.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The two confirmation-bias findings are correctly located. obs_003 fully overlaps the hidden cognitive-dissonance mechanism but uses a distinct label; obs_001 partially overlaps the general persistence of the ex theory but misses the hidden group-convergence mechanism.
The candidate is localized to the bias-free day-one segment and has no relation to a hidden target instance.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: No retrieved chunks, source passages, or retrieval logs were supplied. The RAG explicitly disclosed that no corpus support was used, so corpus fidelity is unavailable and does not affect detection scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 1 to 2 and instance true positives from 1 to 2; no false alarms are added.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The low-confidence findings add one segment hit and one mechanism-first true positive, but add two strict false positives; strict F1 falls from 0.8000 to 0.5714 while mechanism-first F1 rises to 0.8571.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The anchoring candidate adds one false alarm and one false positive to each instance scorecard, with no additional true positive; segment F1 falls from 1.0000 to 0.8571.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 2 of 3 positive segments with no false alarms (hit_rate 0.6667, F1 0.8000). Including low-confidence identified findings detects all positive segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance precision is 1.0000, recall 0.6667, and F1 0.8000. The low-confidence confirmation-bias labels do not strictly identify the hidden Cognitive dissonance target.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring recovers the day-three Cognitive dissonance mechanism at the low-confidence threshold, reaching precision 0.7500, recall 1.0000, and F1 0.8571 before candidates are added.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The single candidate is a useful abstention diagnostically, but candidate-inclusive scoring treats it as a false alarm on the neutral day-one segment and lowers both precision and F1.
main_failure_modes: Two low-confidence confirmation-bias labels are not strict matches to the hidden target labels.
The day-three finding uses a near-neighbor label, so strict scoring misses it despite full mechanism overlap.
Counting candidates adds a false alarm without recovering a hidden instance.
main_strengths: The moderate groupthink finding exactly localizes and captures the counterfactual timing mechanism at the briefing.
The high-confidence recency-bias finding is an approved equivalent with full evidence fidelity.
All supplied interview quotations are valid and the output correctly discloses that retrieval support was unavailable.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong segment-level sensitivity once low-confidence findings are admitted, but stricter label-plus-mechanism scoring exposes taxonomy errors. The mechanism-first gap indicates that the RAG often recognized the relevant evidence-reconciliation pattern while naming a neighboring construct.
